preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [N_val for line in stdin_lines if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() or (line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) > 0)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N (number of officers) is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(C, int) and 1 <= C <= 10**9 for C in [C_val for line in stdin_lines if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, C (Chef's coordinate) is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(p, int) and 1 <= p <= 10**9 for p in P) for P in [P_list for line in stdin_lines if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all officer coordinates P_i are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(P)) == len(P) and C not in P for P in [P_list for line in stdin_lines if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: All coordinates (Chef and officers) are unique within each test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(x in ['1', '-1'] for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains two space-separated integers: the first is the count of eliminated officers, and the second is either 1 (Chef runs away) or -1 (Chef is caught).

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == max_eliminated and int(line.split()[1]) == (1 if all_officers_eliminated else -1) for line, (max_eliminated, all_officers_eliminated) in zip(stdout_lines, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first integer is the maximum number of officers Chef can eliminate, and the second integer is 1 if all officers are eliminated (Chef runs away) or -1 otherwise.
